answer: Admit each new agent only through a harbor: an established agent that vouches for it by locking a ferrous bond, collateral frozen while the newcomer is watched. The bond doubles for every newcomer a harbor already shelters, so ten clones behind one sponsor cost 1,023 bonds, not ten. If any clone is caught colluding, all bonds that harbor posted burn and leave an ember on its record that bars it from vouching for 30 epochs. Spreading clones across many harbors needs many real, tenured agents, which is exactly what a sybil lacks.
